sloka: विशस्ते वा गृहीते वा रक्षोभिर्मयि संयुगे ।नान्यं पश्यामि रामस्य साहाय्यं कार्यसाधने ।। ५.३०.३२।।।।
transliteration: viśaste vā gṛhīte vā rakṣobhirmayi saṁyuge ।nānyaṁ paśyāmi rāmasya sāhāyyaṁ kāryasādhane ।। 5.30.32।।।।

translations.english: "If I am killed in the combat or captured by the demons, I do not see another person who can help in accomplishing this task.
